India's Motor Accident Compensation Increased to ₹10 Lakh Despite Lack of Appeal

The AP High Court has enhanced motor accident compensation to ₹10 lakh without an appeal from claimants, citing a legal precedent. This decision affects the lives of many Indians who rely on this compensation for their livelihoods. The ruling highlights the importance of considering functional loss in determining compensation.
